<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1338">
<div class="grid">
<h1 class="ce_headline col-12">
Vacation Homes on Fehmarn at the "Wulfener Hals" Campground</h1>
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">Vacation Homes at Balticpark. Stay in the Heart of Our Campground</h2>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-10 block">
<p>The vacation homes at the "Wulfener Hals" in Balticpark, with their approximately 55 m&sup2;, offer plenty of space for a great vacation. And they&rsquo;re located in a quiet, traffic-calmed area right in the heart of our vacation park. Your vacation starts right away: All vacation homes come fully equipped with bed linens, hand towels, and dish towels upon check-in; they&rsquo;re cozy and furnished to a high standard, and feature a terrace and stylish patio furniture. By the way: As a guest in one of these vacation homes, you can, of course, take advantage of everything the vacation park has to offer.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article section-primary block" id="article-1339">
<div class="compusoft">

<div class="col-12_lg-8 bg-grass grid">
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12_lg-8">Amenities of the "Seeschwalbe" vacation home at Balticpark:</h2>
<div class="ce_hyperlink button button-primary col-12_md-4 block">
<a href="https://v3.onlinebooking.dk/V3WULFEN/?cbpid=468" class="hyperlink_txt" title="Jetzt Verf&uuml;gbarkeit pr&uuml;fen">Check Availability Now</a>
</div>
<div class="ce_text col-12 block">
<ul>
<li>Location: Detached vacation home in the heart of the vacation park</li>
<li>Size: 55 square meters</li>
<li>Capacity: four people</li>
<li>Open-concept living room/kitchen with dining area</li>
<li>Two bedrooms with 2.00-meter box-spring beds</li>
<li>Bathroom with shower, separate toilet</li>
<li>Dishwasher, glass-ceramic stove, and microwave; refrigerator with freezer compartment</li>
<li>TV and stereo system, safe</li>
<li>Desk with chair</li>
<li>Parking right next to the house</li>
<li>Basic Wi-Fi connection at no charge</li>
<li>Covered 15-square-meter terrace with patio furniture</li>
<li>Dogs: Not allowed</li>
</ul>
</div>
